# Branch naming

When you create or suggest a branch name for HackGreenville.com:

- Branch from `develop`
- Use the format `{type}/{description}`
- Prefer short, meaningful, unique, kebab-case descriptions
- Avoid issue numbers in branch names

Common prefixes:

- `feat/` for new features
- `fix/` for bug fixes
- `docs/` for documentation changes
- Other conventional prefixes are acceptable when they fit the work

Examples:

- `feat/add-sponsors`
- `fix/calendar-popup-css`
- `docs/typos-in-readme`
